name: Kathryn Lapucelle
original_name: キャスリン・ラピュセル
source:
A young Zero Knight with the rare ability to enhance the capabilities of others. She is also a talented tactician. One of the three Zero Knights of Kingdom of Eden, but she is a Zero Knight under the Kingdom of Eden only by name. Because of special circumstances and her major contributions to the Arthur Tragedy, she was promoted to Zero Knight at a young age. 

[spoiler]Currently recluse from society undertaking peculiar kinds of research while relying on the Amuzon delivery service to sustain herself.[/spoiler] 

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1061]Mangagamer[/url]]
